output: The identical registry command was replayed from a physical Git archive at the semantic RED SHA with only the final contract test overlaid. It collected six tests and produced 1 pass / 5 semantic failures after reaching the versioned production sources. The failures proved that dead widgets, live legacy-provider references and app registration were still present, while the real simulator still required the legacy provider and lacked the generic liquidity-crisis copy plus actionable absent-profile route. These were not missing-file, import, syntax, command, fixture or harness failures. The contract used synthetic profiles only and no private certificate or real financial data.
